test_cases.summary:
Verify Display IN_REVIEW L images
when Select Status is IN_REVIEW
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Awaiting Approval – Final Level
As a final reviewer, the user wants to see images awaiting action.

Scenario: Display IN_REVIEW L images
Given Select Status is IN_REVIEW
And Awaiting Approval is checked
When the image grid is displayed
Then IN_REVIEW L images should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
IN_REVIEW L images should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the image grid is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Enable Accept and Reject for IN_REVIEW L
when an IN_REVIEW L image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Final Actions – Accept & Reject
As a final reviewer, the user wants to take decision on images.

Scenario: Enable Accept and Reject for IN_REVIEW L
Given an IN_REVIEW L image is selected
When the image action panel is viewed
Then Accept and Reject buttons should be enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
Accept and Reject buttons should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when the image action panel is viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image moves to ACCEPTED on Accept
when an IN_REVIEW  image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Final Acceptance Workflow
As a final reviewer, the user wants to accept the image.

Scenario: Image moves to ACCEPTED on Accept
Given an IN_REVIEW  image is selected
When the user clicks Accept
Then the image should move to ACCEPTED status
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move to ACCEPTED status
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Accept.

test_cases.summary:
Verify ACCEPTED status available after final acceptance
when the image is accepted at final level
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Status Filter – ACCEPTED
As a user, the user wants to filter accepted images.

Scenario: ACCEPTED status available after final acceptance
Given the image is accepted at final level
When the user views Select Status options
Then ACCEPTED status should be available
test_cases.acceptance:
ACCEPTED status should be available
The behavior should be validated when the user views Select Status options.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display accepted image under ACCEPTED status
when the user selects ACCEPTED from Select Status dropdown
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Image Listing – ACCEPTED
As a user, the user wants to view accepted images.

Scenario: Display accepted image under ACCEPTED status
Given the user selects ACCEPTED from Select Status dropdown
When the image grid is displayed
Then the accepted image should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The accepted image should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the image grid is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Assignee views accepted images
when the image is in ACCEPTED status
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Visibility – Assignee Accepted Images
As an assignee, the user wants to view accepted images.

Scenario: Assignee views accepted images
Given the image is in ACCEPTED status
When the assignee logs in and selects ACCEPTED
Then the accepted image should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The accepted image should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the assignee logs in and selects ACCEPTED.

test_cases.summary:
Verify All approval levels view accepted images
when the image is in ACCEPTED status
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Visibility – All Approval Levels
As a system, accepted images must be visible to all approval levels.

Scenario: All approval levels view accepted images
Given the image is in ACCEPTED status
When any approval level user selects ACCEPTED
Then the accepted image should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The accepted image should be visible
The behavior should be validated when any approval level user selects ACCEPTED.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display ACCEPTED indicator on image
when an accepted image is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Accepted Indicator
As a user, the user wants clear accepted status visibility.

Scenario: Display ACCEPTED indicator on image
Given an accepted image is displayed
When the image card is viewed
Then ACCEPTED status should be displayed inside the image
test_cases.acceptance:
ACCEPTED status should be displayed inside the image
The behavior should be validated when the image card is viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify User can edit image only at their active approval level
when an image is in IN_REVIEW status at a specific approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Role & approval level based image access control

Scenario: User can edit image only at their active approval level

Given an image is in IN_REVIEW status at a specific approval level
And the user belongs to the same active approval level
When the user opens the image on the Data Labeling page
Then all edit and action controls (Annotation, Zoom, Rotate, Pen, Brightness, etc.) should be enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
All edit and action controls (Annotation, Zoom, Rotate, Pen, Brightness, etc.) should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the image on the Data Labeling page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image becomes non-editable for previous level after moving forward
when an image is accepted and moved to the next approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Edit restriction for previous approval level

Scenario: Image becomes non-editable for previous level after moving forward

Given an image is accepted and moved to the next approval level
When a user from the previous approval level opens the same image
Then all image edit and action controls should be disabled and image should be read-only
test_cases.acceptance:
All image edit and action controls should be disabled and image should be read-only
The behavior should be validated when a user from the previous approval level opens the same image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image becomes editable only for the new active level after rejection
when an image is rejected and moved back to a previous approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Access update when image moves backward in workflow

Scenario: Image becomes editable only for the new active level after rejection

Given an image is rejected and moved back to a previous approval level
When a user from the new active level opens the image
Then the image should be editable, and controls enabled only for that level
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be editable, and controls enabled only for that level
The behavior should be validated when a user from the new active level opens the image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify System blocks edit actions by non-active level users
when a user does not belong to the current active approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unauthorized edit attempt blocking

Scenario: System blocks edit actions by non-active level users

Given a user does not belong to the current active approval level
When the user attempts any edit or action on the image (via UI or shortcut)
Then the system shall block the action and prevent modification
test_cases.acceptance:
The system shall block the action and prevent modification
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts any edit or action on the image (via UI or shortcut).

test_cases.summary:
Verify Edit and action controls are hidden or disabled for unauthorized users
when a user opens an image outside their approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: UI-level access enforcement

Scenario: Edit and action controls are hidden or disabled for unauthorized users

Given a user opens an image outside their approval level
When the Data Labeling page loads
Then edit icons, buttons, and shortcuts should be disabled or non-interactive
test_cases.acceptance:
Edit icons, buttons, and shortcuts should be disabled or non-interactive
The behavior should be validated when the Data Labeling page loads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Backend validates role and approval level before allowing image actions
when a user attempts an image action through API or forced UI trigger
test_cases.description:
Feature: Backend authorization validation

Scenario: Backend validates role and approval level before allowing image actions

Given a user attempts an image action through API or forced UI trigger
When role, approval level, or group mapping does not match active level
Then the backend shall reject the request and not apply changes
test_cases.acceptance:
The backend shall reject the request and not apply changes
The behavior should be validated when role, approval level, or group mapping does not match active level.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Only one approval level has edit access at any time
when the image exists across multiple workflow stages
test_cases.description:
Feature: Single active-level edit enforcement

Scenario: Only one approval level has edit access at any time

Given the image exists across multiple workflow stages
When users from different approval levels access the image simultaneously
Then only the current active level user should be able to edit the image
test_cases.acceptance:
Only the current active level user should be able to edit the image
The behavior should be validated when users from different approval levels access the image simultaneously.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image grid loads smoothly for Approval Level 1 user
when the user logs in as Approval Level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval workflow performance across levels

Scenario: Image grid loads smoothly for Approval Level 1 user

Given the user logs in as Approval Level
When the Data Labeling page is opened
Then image grid, session details, and status indicators should load without noticeable delay
test_cases.acceptance:
Image grid, session details, and status indicators should load without noticeable delay
The behavior should be validated when the Data Labeling page is opened.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image acceptance at Level completes without delay
when an image is in IN_REVIEW state
test_cases.description:
Feature: Accept action responsiveness

Scenario: Image acceptance at Level completes without delay

Given an image is in IN_REVIEW state
When the Level user clicks Accept
Then the image status should update and move to Level 2 immediately
test_cases.acceptance:
The image status should update and move to Level 2 immediately
The behavior should be validated when the Level user clicks Accept.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Image loads quickly for Approval Level after Level acceptance
when the image has moved to IN_REVIEW
test_cases.description:
Feature: Approval workflow performance continuity

Scenario: Image loads quickly for Approval Level after Level acceptance

Given the image has moved to IN_REVIEW
When the Level user logs in and opens the session
Then the image and action buttons should load promptly
test_cases.acceptance:
The image and action buttons should load promptly
The behavior should be validated when the Level user logs in and opens the session.
